summary: Verified all four fixes from the main agent's latest turn on the Encar Bulgarian/Romanian/English skin. BUG1 (filters lost on back), BUG2 (raw enum panel codes), BUG3 (save button placement/behaviour), and BUG4 (auto-sort rules) are all working as specified. Verified on desktop 1920px and mobile 390px, plus one backend API assertion for BUG2.

verification_details.BUG1_desktop: Opened /?make=BMW&year_min=2018&sort=price_asc&page=2, clicked car-row-details-button, then clicked back-to-results. URL restored exactly to /?make=BMW&year_min=2018&sort=price_asc&page=2 and applied-filters chips show 'Make: BMW' and 'Year: 2018-'. PASS.
verification_details.BUG1_mobile: 390x844 viewport, clicked car-card-details-button then back-to-results. URL restored to the exact filtered/sorted/paginated URL. PASS.
verification_details.BUG2_api: GET /api/car/42244072?lang=bg diagnosis.items[*].panel returned humanised names: 'Front door left', 'Back door left', 'Trunk lid', 'Back door right', 'Front door right', 'Hood', 'Front fender right', 'Front fender left'. No underscores, first letter only capitalised. PASS.
verification_details.BUG2_ui: Regex /[A-Z]{2,}_[A-Z]/ over [data-testid=detail-diagnosis] text returned 0 matches. PASS.
verification_details.BUG3_placement: detail-save-button count=1. Price bbox x=1362.25 y=137 h=36; Save bbox x=1487 y=142 h=44. save.x > price.x = True and vertical centres overlap (inline row). PASS.
verification_details.BUG3_toggle: Clicking detail-save-button flips label Save -> Saved (heart fills). PASS.
verification_details.BUG4_a_none: Landing on / with no selection -> sort=newest. PASS.
verification_details.BUG4_b_make_only: Selecting Make=BMW -> URL sort=newest (previously incorrectly flipped to price_asc). PASS.
verification_details.BUG4_c_make_model: Adding Model=1 Series (E82) -> URL sort=price_asc. PASS.
verification_details.BUG4_d_make_model_submodel: Adding submodel/badge=120d Coupe -> URL sort=price_asc. PASS.
verification_details.BUG4_manual_override: After manually setting sort=price_desc and then selecting a model, sort stayed price_desc (auto-sort did not override user choice). PASS.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend _panel_label helper works but should ideally live in a shared utils module rather than server.py to keep server.py from growing further.

Auto-sort useEffect logic relies on distinguishing user-changed sort from auto-set sort via a ref/flag; ensure that flag resets correctly if user later Clears all filters, so browsing default returns to 'newest'. Not tested here explicitly but worth a follow-up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All four turn-scope bugs verified fixed. Test ids used: car-row-details-button, car-card-details-button, back-to-results, applied-filters, detail-price, detail-save-button, detail-diagnosis. Native <select> order on search page is [make, model, submodel, sort]. For BUG4 manual-override coverage, remember the check requires manually changing the sort dropdown BEFORE picking model/submodel.
